# BinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy

`binaryauthorization.gcp.hfl.dev/v1beta1`

**Gap it fills.** Terraform's `google_binary_authorization_platform_policy`. A Binary Authorization platform policy: the checks GKE's continuous validation runs on a cluster's pods (platform is gke).

**Source.** generated by `hack/discokind` from the binaryauthorization.v1 Discovery document.

## Notes

Generated by `hack/discokind` from `hack/discokind/kinds.yaml` (`docs/design.md`
section 2.4); its test is `pkg/discokind/kindtest` with the fixtures under
`pkg/controller/direct/binaryauthorization/discokindtest/testdata/discokind/BinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy/`.

The stable equivalent (decision 26) of Config Connector's alpha-only
`BinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy` (foundation item 25, 2026-11-23), with
the API's field set (`description`, `gkePolicy`). `platform` is `gke`;
`etag` is left out. The API has no patch: an update is
`replacePlatformPolicy`, a PUT of the whole policy (`kinds.yaml`
`updateMethod`), so the controller sends the whole spec, and what the spec
leaves out is cleared.

Tested by kindtest on `pkg/discokind/fake`: a policy with an allowlist and
a check set of freshness and trusted directory checks, then only its
description changed (the replace carries the rest), delete, abandon. The
fake checks no check set.

Live: pending. `task test-live PROJECT=$GCP_PROJECT
KINDS=binaryauthorization LIVE_RUN=TestBinaryAuthorizationPlatformPolicy`
(needs `binaryauthorization.googleapis.com` on and
`roles/binaryauthorization.policyAdmin`; free). `hack/live/sweep.sh` lists
GKE's platform policies by the run's name.
